_comment: The sky wanders slowly through colours no sky should be (Jonah, 2026-10-12): `strength` is how far it is
drawn from its own colour, and `pace` how fast it moves from one to the next.
Strange throughout: seen only. The colours come from a short uncanny palette, drawn per Age from its seed,
and keep the brightness of the sky they tint, so the night stays dark.
Never bought where the book set `sky.shifting`.
